1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of __C1-C12-alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, wherein R2 is not ethyl__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is __C1-C12-alkyl, excluding ethyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl__.

3. (Original) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (II a) in which R2 is methyl or ethyl.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein Z is not potassium__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (Il b) in which Z is sodium __or another alkali metal other than potassium__.
